questList.title: Quests
questList.hint: Quests are orthogonal to the structure: they carry objectives and unlock conditions, and can span several scenes.

questEdit.subtitle: Quest
questEdit.optionalHint: Only the title is required. Expand and fill in only the sections you need — everything else is optional.
questEdit.descriptionPlaceholder: Describe the objective and context of the quest...
questEdit.illustrationsHint: Portraits, moods and notable locations of the quest.
questEdit.unlockHint: All conditions must be met (AND) for the quest to unlock in a Playthrough. Empty = available from the start. Progression is managed in the Playthrough screen.
questEdit.nodesHint: OPTIONAL — only use this if the quest should TRAVERSE existing content (“the quest passes through these places”). These are links: removing a node deletes nothing. Without nodes, the quest automatically gets its own scene space (created on the fly, with its map).
questEdit.gmNotesPlaceholder: Private notes about the quest, twists, secrets...
questEdit.relatedPagesHint: Link this quest to NPCs, places or Lore elements that appear in it.
questEdit.noLoreHint: 💡 This campaign is not linked to any universe. Link it to a Lore from the campaign screen to attach Lore pages to this quest.

nodePicker.empty: No node attached yet. This quest isn't linked to any chapter or scene.
